description: Permission-aware agent-memory recall regression dataset (Priority 4). 9 expected_outcome=pass cases covering relevant recall, irrelevant exclusion, private-memory isolation in BOTH directions (Alice must not see Bob's and vice versa), project-scope membership and non-membership, superseded exclusion and deleted exclusion -- plus 1 negative control that asserts Alice recalls Bob's private memory, which MUST fail at the retrieval stage. That control is the load-bearing case: if the visibility filter ever regressed into a leak, it would start passing, and the expected-outcome CI gate turns that into a build failure rather than a silently greener report.
